Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
edges.note: Where R1 improves reasoning via RL over full token output, NF-CoT moves reasoning into continuous latent space with normalizing flows.

edges.target_label: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
edges.note: NF-CoT directly addresses open problems catalogued in the latent reasoning survey.

edges.target_label: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows (NF-CoT)
edges.note: Replaces GRPO reward-based approximation with normalizing-flow exact log-likelihoods in latent reasoning space.

edges.target_label: PauseRec: Implicit Reasoning for LLM-based Generative Recommendation (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought writes the reasoning out as text, PauseRec keeps the extra computation but drops the text through inserted pause steps.

edges.target_label: PauseRec: Implicit Reasoning for LLM-based Generative Recommendation (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trains long explicit reasoning traces, PauseRec reaches most of the benefit at lower training cost with implicit pauses.

edges.target_label: RLVR Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 measured success by the final answer under verifiable-reward RL, this paper introduces CoT-Pass@K to score the correctness of the intermediate steps directly.

edges.target_label: RLVR Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought treated the reasoning trace as a prompting device, this paper treats trace correctness as the quantity the reward implicitly shapes.

edges.target_label: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought keeps reasoning inside one text trace, this paper moves to an act-observe-reason loop so a wrong step can be corrected by evidence.

edges.target_label: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trained long single-pass reasoning traces, this paper frames reasoning as an agentic control loop rather than one output.

edges.target_label: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT added tool calls as a capability, this paper makes the tool call part of a reasoning policy.

edges.target_label: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 optimized a single model for correctness and let the reasoning style drift, Tandem RL adds a frozen weak junior to the rollout and rewards the pair so the trace stays legible.

edges.target_label: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought asked for legible steps through prompting, Tandem RL makes legibility an emergent property of the training structure rather than a prompt instruction.

edges.target_label: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought externalizes reasoning as text tokens, MentalThink externalizes each step as executable SVG that is rendered and inspected before revision.

edges.target_label: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 rewards correct final answers, MentalThink keeps the reinforcement-learning outer loop but rewards useful inspection and revision of a rendered drawing.

edges.target_label: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World (2026)
edges.note: Where the survey mapped the space of multimodal reasoning methods, MentalThink adds an executable-sketch reasoning mode with a checkable intermediate representation.

edges.target_label: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 rewards trajectories the model already samples, TREK first imports verified off-support solutions through a short distillation phase, then reinforces.

edges.target_label: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine (2026)
edges.note: TREK targets the exploration stall the Group Relative Policy Optimization family shares by warming up on verified off-support solutions before on-policy reinforcement.

edges.target_label: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought draws reasoning out of a frozen pretrained model by prompting, this paper measures how the pretraining stage sets the ceiling and speed of the later RL stage, separating the contribution of pretraining from that of RL.

edges.target_label: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trains reasoning through RL with verifiable rewards, this paper shows post-RL reward is predicted by pretraining loss and that RL surfaces correct moves nearly absent before rather than only sharpening the fine-tuned policy.

edges.target_label: Group Entropy-Controlled Policy Optimization (GEPO) (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 applied one reward-normalization scheme uniformly across all prompts, GEPO conditions the advantage shaping on each group's estimated entropy so easy low-entropy and hard high-entropy prompts get different exploration pressure.

edges.target_label: Group Entropy-Controlled Policy Optimization (GEPO) (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-V3 is the base-model lineage behind the R1 reasoning recipe; GEPO modifies the GRPO advantage normalization that recipe standardized.

edges.target_label: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Asynchronous RL (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 assumed near on-policy rollouts, this paper stabilizes verifiable-reward reinforcement learning when rollouts are stale because generation and training are decoupled for speed.

edges.target_label: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Asynchronous RL (2026)
edges.note: Where PPO clips a fixed symmetric ratio band on every token, SAT keeps that band on ordinary tokens and contracts only the outward endpoint on tokens flagged as stale, so the constraint follows the actual mismatch.

edges.target_label: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Asynchronous RL (2026)
edges.note: Where Latent-GRPO and the GSPO family treat the group as uniformly trustworthy, SAT weights the update by per-token staleness within the group.

edges.target_label: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL (2026)
edges.note: Where PPO clips updates on a single-sample importance ratio, this paper replaces the direction test with a predicted change in the trust-region divergence itself, because the ratio is a noisy proxy that can point the wrong way.

edges.target_label: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 made RL from verifiable rewards the standard recipe for reasoning models, this paper sharpens the trust-region machinery underneath rather than changing the reward or the task.

edges.target_label: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL (2026)
edges.note: Where Latent-GRPO is a group-relative policy-optimization variant relying on the ratio-based mask, this paper supplies a consistent direction test that predicts the change in the same divergence the proximity test measures.

edges.target_label: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research (2026)
edges.note: Where the Agent AI survey framed the loop of perception, planning, and tool use, AREX adds an outer self-improvement loop that audits intermediate answers and re-plans from the partially verified state.

edges.target_label: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS searches a tree of actions and backtracks within a single pass, AREX adds an outer loop that verifies intermediate answers and re-plans, because deep research rewards constraint-checking more than searching longer.

edges.target_label: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research (2026)
edges.note: Where ToolkenGPT learned to call external tools as special tokens, AREX learns a context-update tool that compresses its own growing memory into verified evidence and open constraints without an external model.

edges.target_label: Skill Self-Play: Co-Evolving Skills (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trained reasoning against a fixed pool of verifiable problems, Skill Self-Play makes the problem set a moving target by generating new tasks conditioned on skills so the training distribution grows with the model.

edges.target_label: Skill Self-Play: Co-Evolving Skills (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought fixed the reasoning format at inference time, Skill Self-Play moves the structure into training and lets a skill library expand over time.

edges.target_label: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trains against a single fixed reward, DecoEvo makes the grading rubric a separately audited moving target, so the signal keeps separating good answers from bad ones once the solver saturates it.

edges.target_label: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought fixes the reasoning trace format at prompt time, DecoEvo edits external solver and rubric text rather than weights and updates each artifact from a distinct signal.

edges.target_label: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 trains with sparse final verifiable rewards, CAST keeps the RLVR frame but adds a dense per-turn credit term, because sparse terminal reward is what makes long-horizon credit assignment hard.

edges.target_label: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: Where LATS uses a value estimate at search time to guide tree rollouts, CAST uses a solver's value changes at training time to shape the policy gradient.

edges.target_label: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents (2026)
edges.note: CAST pushes toward process-level supervision of the reasoning trace rather than the outcome-only supervision behind chain-of-thought prompting.

edges.target_label: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 assigns one advantage to the whole response under GRPO, CoRT splits that advantage across tokens using the model's own likelihood contrasts between a rubric-conditioned and a criteria-free prompt, adding within-response credit without an auxiliary scoring model.

edges.target_label: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought exposes intermediate reasoning in text, CoRT does not change the text; it changes which tokens the policy update rewards, keeping the response-level reward fixed.

edges.target_label: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 used outcome reward to make reasoning chains longer, this paper shapes reward to make them stop, because outcome-only reward gives no signal separating a hard-won failure from a correct refusal.

edges.target_label: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: Where Chain-of-Thought treated the verbalized trace as always beneficial, this paper measures the regime in which the trace is actively harmful, burning compute and producing plausible wrong answers.

edges.target_label: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
edges.note: DeepSeek-R1 established group-relative policy optimisation against verifiable rewards as the standard reasoning post-training recipe; this paper identifies its entropy collapse as the cost and removes the gradient estimator that causes it.

edges.target_label: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
edges.note: PPO is the policy-gradient ancestor whose ratio-clipping structure GRPO inherits, and whose entropy behaviour is the object of comparison here.

edges.target_label: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
edges.note: Latent-GRPO changes where the GRPO objective acts but keeps the same gradient estimator; this paper replaces the estimator itself with a gradient-free population search.

edges.target_label: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-R1 trained reasoning by reinforcement learning against a verifiable reward and stopped where no verifier exists; J-Zero replaces the verifier with a Judge that is trained alongside the Solver.

edges.target_label: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data (2026)
edges.note: Chain-of-Thought used decomposition to improve one answer at inference time; J-Zero repurposes decomposition as a construction that reliably produces the better member of a preference pair.

edges.target_label: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-R1 established that reasoning can be trained by reinforcement learning against verifiable rewards using sparse outcome-level advantages; this paper shows the dense per-token teacher signal offered as the alternative is largely uninformative and can be replaced by a self-computed entropy-adaptive advantage.

edges.target_label: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? (2026)
edges.note: Chain-of-Thought established that reasoning gains come from the structure of intermediate token sequences; this paper tests whether that structure is what on-policy distillation transfers and finds the teacher's judgement of it is not what the student depends on.

edges.target_label: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-V3 supplies the large-teacher regime the method assumes is cleaner; the paper measures that supervision noise grows with teacher capacity instead of falling.
